title: Fixed term footprints and cardinality-driven reserves avoid elapsed-history growth

statement.quantifiers: Every fixed BGS/Rossman HF term built from the listed primitives, every finite native run prefix on unary/binary input n>=2, W=n+4+max_i inclusive hereditary closure size.
statement.assertion: All actually reached subterm/binding closures fit a fixed polynomial q_t(W); the Card reserve grows to max(previous top, actual argument cardinalities), at most q_t(W), with max semantic universe W+2Q(W)+1 for fixed Q dominating all footprints. Runtime h does not enter.
assumptions: Fixed syntax: variables,Atoms,Empty,Boolean,Pair,Union,TheUnique,standard HF Card,bounded comprehension; no powerset/choice/succinct integers.
Only actual native environments are evaluated, not arbitrary ambient reserve elements.
Keep input atoms/constants, full ordinal reserve and a transitive closure of current state, clearing scratch tables between steps.

inputs: Native term and inclusive hereditary cardinality peak of a finite prefix; W is a proof parameter, not provided to the program.
outputs: Fixed parameter-free FO+ordinary unary Hartig state simulation with polynomial peak domain and runtime-independent exponent.
interface.precision: Exact semantic cardinalities and explicit von Neumann ordinals; peak-over-run, not instantaneous size or general bit storage.
costs: Program constants/exponents depend on fixed nesting/register syntax.
Full generated FO compiler was not supplied/executed; semantic finite scripts do not certify it.
Imported lower-bound proof and external correctness/novelty remain unverified.

proof_mechanism: Bound the union of all eager body/guard subterm objects at each bounded comprehension using at most q_range(m) native bindings.
Generate ordinal predecessors explicitly; compare frozen actual member sets against reserve ordinals using unary Hartig.
Advance ordinal top only if a realized cardinality lacks a match; reuse an already represented next ordinal.
After each native step restrict exact stored closure to the transitive kept set and reset binding/descriptor scratch.
Use footprints of native states, never feed prior ambient reserve into the term-footprint recurrence.
obstructions: Retaining all prior native values gives exponential counter-subset history despite small individual states.
Intermediate n² pair Card defeats a linear current-native-size reserve.
No bound in current instantaneous size, no runtime or input-polynomial bound, no broader HF primitives.

potential_uses.target: Peak-state reductions for fixed HF computations
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Verify the exact term syntax, native-only environments, explicit ordinal closure and transitive reset invariant; compose only with a resettable compiler and separately validated hard-pair lower bound.

review.source_reported: Source independent internal reconstruction and semantic finite checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
